newSections.basis: Bavarian survey authority exhibition catalogue, printed p.3 (PDF p.9), explicitly identifies the 1973 commission markers as the present 422 km Bavaria/Saxony/Thuringia boundary. Falkenstein 1949 adjustment and 1957/1980 aerial boundary illustrations reviewed. Conservative window excludes the Hessian corner and Czech exterior; no independent period-vector positional accuracy claim.

Bavarian survey continuity statement corroborated by Saxon Green Belt regulation identifying the former DDR border strip along the Saxony/Bavaria land boundary. Southern cutoff excludes the Czech tripoint; existing LSIB exterior remains unchanged.

Niedersachsen political education authority, Das Eichsfeld (2002), printed p.17/PDF p.18 explicitly records the former state border becoming the Niedersachsen/Hessen-Thuringia land boundary on 1990-10-03. Only the northern Eichsfeld interval is admitted; southern Wendebach and unreviewed Werra intervals excluded.

Nationalpark Harz, Gewaesser im Nationalpark Harz, PDF p.29: the Ecker from source to Harz foothills is the current state boundary and was the DDR/BRD boundary until reunification. LGLN NaVKV 2/3 2010, printed p.41, independently documents the reservoir/dam boundary and retained marker. Restricted Ecker/reservoir interval, not all Harz.

Official Geismar land-reorganisation plan, maps PDF pp.1-3 (1:5000, dated 2015-12-09) and text PDF p.30/printed p.10 identify the former border strip along its western edge adjoining Hessen. The western state boundary is distinguished from the internal Kolonnenweg. Restricted Geismar/Spahl/Roedgen interval, south of Point Alpha; corroborated by the federal Green Belt explanation of the former strip between land boundary and Kolonnenweg. Visual/documentary continuity only, not a digitized 1989 positional test.

historicalAccuracy: documentary continuity plus visual review; no independent 1989 vector, no 0.5px pass claim
